02-31.solution: Rectangle \(= 15 \times 10 = 150\). Quarter circle \(= \frac{1}{4} \times 3.14 \times 10^2 = 78.5\). Remaining area \(= 150 - 78.5 = 71.5\) cm².

02-36.solution: The circumradius of an equilateral triangle of side \(a\) is \(\frac{a}{\sqrt{3}}\). So \(r = \frac{a}{\sqrt{3}}\) and \(a = r\sqrt{3}\).
